A free library of AI skills and workflows that turn Databox metrics into reports

Databox already lets you build dashboards from your marketing, sales, and revenue data. The Skills Marketplace adds a layer on top: instead of staring at a dashboard and writing the summary yourself, you run a skill inside Claude that pulls your live Databox metrics through MCP and hands back a finished, structured report. There are also workflows, which do the same thing on autopilot through n8n, so a report shows up on a schedule without you asking for it. Databox launched this on Product Hunt and it landed as the #2 Product of the Day, with over 26 pre-built products spanning marketing, ads, SEO, social, and ecommerce.

## Common questions

What is the Databox Skills Marketplace?

The Databox Skills Marketplace is a free library of AI analytics products — skills, workflows today, and agents that turn your live Databox metrics into structured analysis and share-ready reports. You download a product, connect it to your Databox account through the Databox MCP connection, and get a finished report instead of another dashboard to read yourself.

Is there a Claude Skills Marketplace? [...] Who is the Databox Skills Marketplace for?

The Databox Skills Marketplace is for anyone who wants clear, fast insight from their data and confident answers — no waiting on someone to pull a report, no dashboards left spinning. It's for founders, marketers, agencies, and RevOps or data teams who want to manage performance deliberately, not react to it after the fact. Products span marketing, paid ads, SEO, social, ecommerce, and revenue reporting.

Can I submit or request a Skills Marketplace product?

Yes — you can submit a skill or analytics product you've built or request one that doesn't exist yet. Submissions go through a Databox quality review, then the team builds the listing and publishes it for you.

Cookie settings [...] Is there a Claude Skills Marketplace?

Yes — the Databox Skills Marketplace is a free library of ready-to-run Claude skills, workflows, and agents that turn your live Databox metrics into structured analysis and share-ready reports.

What's the difference between a skill and a workflow?

A skill is a single file you run inside an AI client like Claude — through the Databox MCP connection — to turn your Databox data into a specific report on demand. A workflow is a scheduled automation that runs through n8n and delivers that report on a recurring basis without you triggering it. Agents, which handle broader multi-step analysis, are coming soon.
